prompt_en: gaunt tall beggar in a ragged hooded grey cloak, hollow cheeks and sunken eyes, long thin arms holding out an empty wooden bowl, bare feet, faint pale mist around the ankles
nota: Si le das comida te bendice; si lo ignoras, te maldice.

prompt_en: small wiry fairy man in a bright red coat and tall red cap, crooked grin, long pointed nose, grey stubble beard, hunched with a sack of tricks and a tiny lantern
nota: Bromista de abrigo rojo; sus avisos falsos no hacen daño.

prompt_en: shaggy sea-green water horse with a seaweed mane, webbed hooves, glowing pale eyes, brine dripping from its coat, barnacles on its flanks and a torn rope halter
nota: Cambia de forma: caballo marino o duende peludo; las fuentes varían.

prompt_en: colossal lake serpent with a long muscular body of dark green scales, a ridge of spines down its back, wide toothed jaws, pale belly, glowing amber eyes and ribbed fins along its sides
nota: Serpiente de lago colosal; sus coletazos exigen esquiva, no parada.

prompt_en: graceful lake maiden in a flowing pale blue gown woven with water lilies, long dark hair threaded with pearls and reeds, a silver circlet, faint shimmering mist at her feet
nota: Dama del lago pacífica; tres golpes injustos rompen su trato.

prompt_en: lean black water horse with a dripping mane tangled in river weeds, faint fish-scale patches along the neck, glowing green eyes and slightly webbed hooves, wet reeds trailing from its legs
nota: Parece una montura mansa; si montas, te arrastra al agua.

prompt_en: sea maiden with pale blue-green skin, long seaweed-colored hair, a shimmering silver-scaled fish tail, a bodice of overlapping shells, coral jewelry, webbed fingers and glowing eyes
nota: Su canto atrae hacia el agua; interrumpirlo las debilita.

prompt_en: huge shaggy black hound the size of a calf, one burning red eye in the middle of its forehead, long drooping jowls, matted fur, mist swirling around its massive paws
nota: Su aparición presagia muerte; ataca y se retira a la niebla.

prompt_en: massive charcoal-black wolf-like hound with matted fur, blazing orange eyes, long curved claws, a rusted iron collar with a broken chain, and wisps of smoke curling from its jaws
nota: Perro negro de Yorkshire con ojos de brasa; embiste lento y fuerte.

prompt_en: small hunched shaggy house goblin with matted dark brown fur, long crooked fingers, drooping ears, glaring yellow eyes, a ragged cloth around its waist and a cracked clay jug in its hand
nota: Brownie ofendido: lanza cacharros desde rincones oscuros.

prompt_en: small hunched household sprite with tousled russet-brown hair, wrinkled brown skin, large pointed ears, tattered brown rags and bare feet, carrying a tiny broom, kind round eyes
nota: Ayuda si le dejas leche; si le regalas ropa, se marcha.

prompt_en: squat sooty goblin with dark grey skin smudged with ash, glowing orange eyes, small curved horns, a toothy grin, a scorched leather apron and a tiny iron poker, bare feet
nota: Travieso del hogar; bromas rápidas junto al fuego, sin mala fe.

prompt_en: slender mischievous woodland sprite with tousled chestnut hair, pointed ears, small curved horns, a patchwork tunic of moss and leaves, hooved feet, a sly grin and a hazel twig
nota: Se transforma en banco, caballo o ave para engañar al viajero.

prompt_en: tiny red-haired sprite with a pointed green cap, large pointed ears, tattered green tunic and bare feet, holding a glowing pale-blue lantern light, bright mischievous eyes
nota: Aparecen en grupos y desorientan con lucecitas; piden el corte de luna.

prompt_en: tiny wizened mine sprite with a grey-white beard, hooked nose and pointed hat, dusty leather miner's clothes, a small pickaxe and a candle lantern, pale skin and knobby hands
nota: Sus golpes en la roca avisan de derrumbes; en grupo atacan con picos.

prompt_en: gaunt river hag with sickly green skin, long stringy hair full of duckweed, jagged green teeth, unnaturally long thin arms with webbed fingers and bony claws, ragged dark dress dripping with pond water
nota: Se esconde bajo la lenteja de agua y agarra a quien se asoma.

prompt_en: towering old hag with blue-grey skin, wild white hair, a hooked nose, long yellow fangs and curved iron claws, wearing a tattered dark cloak and a necklace of cave stones
nota: Vive en una cueva; golpes lentos de garras de hierro, hay que esquivar.

prompt_en: spectral shape-shifting beast between a great black dog and a shaggy pony, long matted black coat, huge round glowing white eyes, ghostly mist for hooves, a faint chain trailing behind it
nota: Presagio que toma forma de perro o caballo; guía o desvía al viajero.

prompt_en: river hag with pale sea-green skin, long tangled green hair like river weed, sharp teeth, long thin arms with webbed claws, a ragged grey dress, white foam clinging to her shoulders and hair
nota: La espuma del río Tees es su marca; la lanza desde el agua.

prompt_en: gaunt hunched bogey with a bare bone-white skull-like head and sunken glowing eyes, long dangling arms, tattered grey burial rags, and two crossed leg bones tied at its belt
nota: Coco inglés de armarios, escaleras y sótanos; sale de la oscuridad.

prompt_en: small old fen spirit with wrinkled grey skin like wet clay, long white wispy hair and beard, a child-sized body, a cloak of reeds and mud, a gnarled staff, mist curling at his feet
nota: Espíritu de las marismas de Lincolnshire: sube las aguas y trae niebla.

prompt_en: enormous black mastiff-like dog with a thick shaggy coat, heavy shoulders, pale glowing eyes, long drooping ears and a worn leather collar, standing in drifting woodland mist
nota: Dudosa: parece un perro negro inglés; no reconozco la leyenda con seguridad.

prompt_en: giant eel-like worm with a thick pale olive body, a round sucker mouth ringed with small sharp teeth, a row of gill slits along its neck, coiled around a grassy hill
nota: Se regenera si sus trozos se unen; corta junto al río para evitarlo.

prompt_en: bulky lake monster with a flat scaly beaver-like tail, crocodile-like snout and sharp teeth, thick dark brown hide with moss-green patches, small glowing eyes and webbed clawed feet, half-submerged in water
nota: Monstruo galés de lago que inunda; la leyenda lo adormece con una doncella.

prompt_en: colossal sea serpent with a small flat head on a long neck, three dark green humps arching out of the waves, slick hide, pale glowing eyes and trailing seaweed
nota: Críptido de Cornualles (1975-76): cuello y jorobas como partes del jefe.

prompt_en: tall winged humanoid with a grey mottled feathered body, a large owl-like head with pointed ear tufts, huge glowing red eyes, long black clawed hands and wide wings folded behind
nota: Críptido de Mawnan (1976): cae en silencio desde el campanario y se aleja.

prompt_en: lean leaping figure in a long black cloak and tall hat, pale gaunt face with glowing red eyes and a pointed chin, clawed gloves, springy coiled boots, blue flame curling from his mouth
nota: Salta por los tejados; ataca desde lo alto y se aleja de un brinco.

prompt_en: towering humanoid made of living wood and leaves, a bark face with deep green eyes framed by oak leaves, vine-wrapped limbs, a crown of branches and moss-covered shoulders
nota: Motivo de iglesias medievales hecho espíritu del bosque; rebrota si no cortas el corazón.
Personaje de ritual del Primero de Mayo (persona disfrazada de follaje), no criatura.

prompt_en: small clumsy household sprite with tufts of grey hair, floppy ears, a baggy patched sackcloth tunic, big hands and feet, a sleepy slow expression and a wooden pail
nota: Primo gris del brownie en el norte de Inglaterra; trastadas torpes y rápidas.

prompt_en: lanky hag with grey-green skin, stringy dark hair, bulging pale eyes and arms twice as long as her body ending in knobby hands, kneeling beside a stone well in a ragged shawl
nota: Sus brazos larguísimos agarran desde el borde del pozo y se retiran.

prompt_en: gaunt old crone with a long hooked nose, iron teeth and wild grey hair, riding a huge wooden mortar, steering with a pestle and sweeping with a birch broom, patterned ragged shawl
nota: Mortero volador; la choza con patas de gallina puede ser su fase 2.

prompt_en: tall forest spirit with bark-like green-brown skin, a shaggy moss beard and vine hair, small curved horns, glowing green eyes, a coat wrapped the wrong way and worn boots
nota: Imita voces para desorientar; se reconoce por llevar la ropa al revés.

prompt_en: small old man with a bushy grey beard and hair covering most of his body, bright eyes, a tiny red belted shirt, sitting behind a clay stove with a wooden spoon
nota: Protege la casa si lo respetas; se vuelve hostil si lo desprecias.

prompt_en: pale slender girl with greenish skin, long wet green hair tangled with river weeds and water lilies, hollow dark eyes, a tattered wet white shift, bare feet and a wreath of wildflowers
nota: El ajenjo la ahuyenta; su aspecto inocente y su canto son engaño.

prompt_en: bloated old water spirit with slimy green-grey skin, a long tangled beard of algae, a frog-like face with bulging eyes, webbed hands, fish-scaled legs and a hat of water lilies
nota: Rompe presas y ahoga; golpes lentos de brazos palmeados.

prompt_en: tiny thin old crone with a very small head, a body slim as a reed, long tangled black hair, a ragged dark dress, holding a spindle and a tangled ball of thread
nota: Hila de noche y enreda el hilo; rompe la vajilla desde las sombras.

prompt_en: huge three-headed green dragon with dark red belly scales, bat-like wings, three fanged heads breathing flames, thick clawed legs and a spiked tail, perched on a rocky peak
nota: Tres cabezas como partes del jefe: cada una con su aliento y su punto débil.

prompt_en: large bird with the serene head and shoulders of a crowned woman, jewel-blue and gold feathers, a glowing halo, long trailing tail feathers and outstretched wings
nota: Su canto hace olvidar; calma las tormentas al poner huevos junto al mar.

prompt_en: large bird with the sorrowful head and shoulders of a crowned woman, midnight-purple and black feathers tipped with silver, a dark jeweled crown, curved talons and folded wings
nota: Pájaro de la tristeza: su canto atrae y hace olvidar; hermana oscura de Alkonost.

prompt_en: large bird with the calm face of a woman, iridescent bronze and green plumage, a small gold crown, a long peacock-like tail and a rolled scroll gripped in one talon
nota: Ave profeta: revela el siguiente ataque de sus aliados; vuela antes de las tormentas.

prompt_en: small field spirit with earth-brown skin, hair of green grass and wheat stalks, eyes of two different colors, a white linen tunic and bare feet, half-hidden in tall golden grain
nota: Guardián de los campos; se esconde entre el trigo y sorprende al intruso.

prompt_en: large black cat-like barn spirit with sooty fur, glowing red-hot coal eyes, sparks drifting from its whiskers, a tail ending in a flicker of flame, crouched on a heap of straw
nota: Gato negro del granero de secado; lanza brasas y quema la paja.

prompt_en: wrinkled old bathhouse spirit with a long damp grey beard and matted hair, flushed pink skin, birch leaves stuck to his shoulders, a plain linen robe, a bundle of birch twigs and swirling white steam
nota: Espíritu del baño de vapor; sale del vapor y arroja piedras calientes.

prompt_en: small shaggy yard spirit with thick grey hair over most of his body, a tiny farmer's coat and cap, bright green eyes, a wooden hay fork, standing before a haystack
nota: Guardián del corral; imita al dueño o a un animal para confundir.

prompt_en: tall gaunt hag with only one large pale eye, stooped shoulders, a long ragged black dress, sallow grey skin, bony hands and a dark shadow clinging to her back
nota: La desgracia con un solo ojo: maldice; se la engaña con un nombre falso.

prompt_en: slender mountain fairy maiden in a flowing white gown, long wind-blown golden hair, luminous pale skin, a silver bow with an arrow, standing on a rocky ledge among clouds
nota: Hada flechera de las montañas; sus flechas enferman y su danza hechiza.

prompt_en: tall woman in a long white dress and head scarf, shimmering with heat haze, holding a large sickle, eyes bright as the noon sun, standing in a golden wheat field
nota: Aparece a mediodía entre el trigo con una hoz; golpea y se disuelve.

prompt_en: bloated pale-blue drowned man with seaweed hair and beard, glassy white eyes, water streaming from tattered clothes, webbed fingers, algae on his shoulders, rising from dark water
nota: Alma de ahogado que arrastra a los nadadores; solo acecha cerca del agua.

prompt_en: gaunt long-legged beast like a thin shaggy dog with an elongated snout, matted grey fur, ribs showing, a wide screaming mouth full of teeth and hollow glowing eyes
nota: Su alarido nocturno anuncia muerte; ataque sónico desde lejos.

prompt_en: shapeless hairy shadow creature with a huge mouth, glowing yellow eyes and long dangling arms of smoke, hovering low in a dark corner
nota: Coco balcánico sin aspecto fijo; sirve de relleno de sombras en grupo.

prompt_en: towering dog-headed giant with iron-gray fangs, shaggy brown fur, broad shoulders, a rough hide kilt and a heavy spiked club, glaring amber eyes
nota: Gigante con cabeza de perro y dientes de hierro; golpes lentos.

prompt_en: wiry mountain wizard in a long woolen cloak and rounded cap, glowing pale-blue eyes, a long white mustache, one hand raised summoning swirling wind and storm clouds around a wooden staff
nota: Protector de cosechas: su espíritu combate demonios del granizo con viento.

prompt_en: gaunt wolf-headed humanoid with matted grey fur, glowing yellow eyes, long clawed hands, a tattered burial shroud over thin shoulders, bared fangs and pale patchy skin
nota: En los Balcanes es hombre lobo o vampiro; aquí, lobo-humano de aspecto cadavérico.

prompt_en: ghostly pale woman with long loose black hair over her face, a drifting white nightgown, wisps of mist instead of legs, a faint blue glow and long thin hands reaching out
nota: Pesadilla eslava: toma forma de polilla o de mujer conocida.

prompt_en: small hairy hunched goblin with red eyes, donkey-like ears, curved tusks, a long thin tongue, matted black fur, clawed hands and a torn winter shawl
nota: Duendes invernales de las doce noches; saltan a la espalda en banda.

prompt_en: tall horned demon-like figure with shaggy dark brown fur, curled goat horns, a long red tongue, hooved feet, rusty chains with bells at his waist and a bundle of birch rods in hand
nota: Cadenas y varas lentas: hay que esquivar, no se pueden parar.

prompt_en: winter hag spirit with a long iron-grey hooked nose and wild white hair, a white fur-trimmed hooded robe, a spindle in her hand, a pale beautiful mask tied at her belt, snowflakes swirling
nota: Premia a los diligentes y castiga a los holgazanes; invoca a las Perchten.

prompt_en: furry figure in a thick shaggy white and grey coat wearing a carved wooden demon mask with big curved horns and bared teeth, a cowbell at the belt and a long staff
nota: Cortejo de máscaras con cuernos que sigue a Perchta; vienen en grupo.

prompt_en: small bearded mine goblin with olive-green skin, big pointed ears, a long nose, a red hood, patched work clothes and a leather apron, holding a hammer and a handful of pebbles
nota: Espíritu de las minas; lanza piedras desde la oscuridad.

prompt_en: small elf-like nightmare spirit in a pointed grey hat, thin pale limbs, glowing white eyes, long clawed fingers and a cloak of shadow, perched on the edge of a bed
nota: Pesadilla germánica que cambia a gato, perro o mariposa.

prompt_en: stubby lizard-like worm about a meter long with a cat-like head, whiskers and wide yellow eyes, two short clawed front legs and a thick scaly grey-brown body tapering to a short tail
nota: Lagarto-gusano alpino de aliento venenoso; exhala veneno y se esconde.

prompt_en: small hare-like beast with branching deer antlers, feathered wings on its back, two long fangs, soft brown fur and a bushy tail
nota: Broma bávara: liebre con astas, alas y colmillos, nacida de taxidermia.

prompt_en: huge mountain giant with a gnarled root-like body, a long grey beard full of moss and pine needles, a pine-trunk staff, a green woolen cloak and stormy grey eyes
nota: Señor de la montaña y las tormentas; cambia de forma para probar al viajero.

prompt_en: tall hooded figure in a long black monk's robe, face hidden in shadow with two faint glowing eyes, long bony hands holding a dim mining lantern, pale mist rising from the hem
nota: Monje fantasma de las minas; su aparición presagia derrumbes.

prompt_en: giant raven with glossy black feathers, a huge wingspan, a large sharp beak, glowing red eyes, long curved talons and a ragged mantle of night-colored feathers
nota: Cuervo nocturno que se lleva a los niños desvelados; pica en picado.

prompt_en: dark hooded spirit with a thin hunched upper body and a tail of drifting black smoke instead of legs, glowing pale eyes, long spidery fingers and a ghostly horse head of mist at its shoulder
nota: La pesadilla germánica: se posa en el pecho del durmiente.

prompt_en: small bearded sailor sprite in a yellow oilskin coat and sou'wester hat, rosy cheeks, holding a caulking mallet and a tiny ship's lantern, wet bare feet
nota: Duende del barco: ayuda a repararlo; verlo anuncia naufragio.

prompt_en: tiny cheerful gnome with a long white beard, a pointed red cap, a brown work apron, a tiny hammer and needle, rosy cheeks and acorn-sized boots
nota: Trabajan de noche; si los ves o esparces guisantes, huyen resbalando.

prompt_en: hairy wild forest goblin with shaggy brown fur, goat horns and cloven hooves, long arms, a crown of leaves and twigs and bright yellow eyes
nota: Espíritu peludo del bosque con patas de cabra; embiste con fuerza.

prompt_en: stubby lizard-like worm with a cat-like head and two short clawed front legs, dark slate-grey body with orange stripes, coated in stone dust, gleaming eyes
nota: Versión de túneles del Tatzelwurm; acecha en galerías mineras.

prompt_en: tiny old woman made of green moss, with a wrinkled bark-brown face, white lichen hair, a leaf shawl, a mushroom-cap hat, bare feet and kind eyes
nota: Mujeres de musgo amistosas; piden ayuda contra la Cacería Salvaje.

prompt_en: tiny gnome with a pointed grey cap, a short brown beard, a green patched coat, oversized boots and mischievous eyes
nota: Duendes de casa y bosque; amables, pero castigan el desprecio.

prompt_en: scarecrow-like bogeyman with a burlap sack head and a stitched mouth, straw poking from ragged clothes, a crooked wooden pole for a spine, glowing eyes and long stick arms
nota: Espantapájaros-coco: finge ser un muñeco quieto hasta que te acercas.

prompt_en: drifting forest spirit of green mist and fallen leaves, vaguely humanoid, glowing eyes among a crown of twigs, vines trailing like hair, moss clinging to its edges
nota: Genérico: «espíritu del bosque» en alemán; relleno para zonas de arbolado.

prompt_en: spectral horseman on a skeletal black horse with burning eyes, a ragged storm-cloud cloak, an antlered helmet and a hunting horn, pale spectral hounds running at his heels
nota: Jinete espectral y su jauría; la carga no se para, se esquiva.

prompt_en: beautiful siren-like maiden with long golden hair and a flowing blue gown, standing on a river rock holding a golden comb, a faint blue glow and watery mist at her feet
nota: Sirena del Rin inventada por Brentano en 1801; su canto desorienta.

prompt_en: small earth dwarf with a wrinkled grey-brown face, a long white beard, a coat of dark green moss, a pointed hat, sturdy leather boots, a lantern and a little shovel
nota: Enanos de tierra alpinos; ayudan al campesino y se marchan si los espían.

prompt_en: small hunched ghostly goblin with grey translucent skin, long thin limbs and big gripping hands, glowing white eyes and a tattered cloak, clinging low as if riding on someone's back
nota: Se sube a tu espalda y pesa más con cada paso; esquiva para sacudirlo.
Dudosa: solo conozco a Eckbert como personaje humano de un cuento de Tieck.

prompt_en: giant cave snail with a huge spiral shell of dark stone-grey, a slimy bluish body, many long snake-like tentacles reaching from its head, small glowing eyes and wet glistening skin
nota: Caracol gigante de cuevas pirenaicas; sus tentáculos agarran desde la oscuridad.
